description: Differentiate an expression symbolically, exactly: "x^3 + 2x", "sin(x)*cos(x)", "x^x". Keeps units, so d/dx (3 m * x) is "3 m" and not 3. Can take higher-order derivatives and evaluate the result at a point. Says which name it read as a unit, and refuses to answer "0" when the variable is not in the expression.

at.description: Also evaluate the derivative at this value of the variable

variable.description: Differentiate with respect to this (guessed if omitted)

name: calc_derive
